_fixture.WHAT_THIS_IS: The second of two hand-built fixtures in the SHAPE of a MobSF Android report. MobSF was NOT run to produce it.
_fixture.WHY_TWO: A ranking of one application is a number, not a ranking. This is the SAME application family one version earlier, which makes the pair a controlled comparison: v1.0 ships unobfuscated, v1.2 is R8-processed. Both configure an OkHttp certificate pin. A class-name-based pinning detector finds it in v1.0 and misses it in v1.2. That is the whole of README section 5.2.
_fixture.WHAT_IS_REAL: Every value is a measurement of CMPen-Android-App v1.0 taken on 2026-08-12 with aapt2 (build-tools 35.0.1), jadx 1.5.3 CLI, apksigner 35.0.1, unzip and grep. jadx reported 1,757 classes and 'finished with errors, count: 8'; the decompiled tree holds 1,995 .java files.
_fixture.WHAT_IS_NOT_REAL: Report structure, rule identifiers, severity strings, cvss numbers and the security_score are reconstructions of MobSF's documented shape. Do not cite them as MobSF's.
_fixture.TARGET: CMPen-Android-App v1.0 (org.android.cmpen) - a public, deliberately-vulnerable training application.
